content: Patients with diabetes who are scheduled to undergo surgery are at an elevated risk of experiencing hyperglycemia due to the physiological stress induced by the surgical procedure. It is recommended to perform a thorough preoperative glucose assessment to optimize glycemic control. The target blood glucose levels should ideally be maintained within the range of 80 to 180 mg/dL. If the patient is currently taking SGLT2 inhibitors as part of their diabetes management regimen, these medications should be discontinued 3 to 4 days prior to the surgery. This precaution is necessary to minimize the risk of developing ketoacidosis, a potentially life-threatening complication.
